findings.title: Android app crashes on launch after 4.2 update (Northwind warehouse users)
findings.description: Warehouse staff on Android report the app crashes immediately on tap, before reaching the login/splash screen, since the last app update. Non-updated Android users and all iOS users are unaffected, giving a clean correlation to the update. Roughly a dozen users have reported it directly at this site, but the customer argues warehouse workers rarely file tickets and the real affected count is likely 3x higher (30+), since non-reporters just silently stop using the app. Impact is concentrated on newly onboarded seasonal hires whose first exposure to the program is the broken launch.
findings.quote: A bunch of our warehouse folks on Android say the app won't open anymore. It crashes the second they tap the icon.
findings.severity_reason: Core app use is completely blocked at launch for an affected population that is likely underreported by 3x, with only a fiddly/unreliable reinstall workaround for already-updated users; it hits new seasonal hires at first touch, hurting adoption of the whole program.
findings.match_note: Same symptom and scope as PROJ-110: Android-only crash-on-launch correlated with the 4.2 release, iOS unaffected; adding Northwind Logistics as a second affected account.

findings.title: Company name misspelled "BetterBrak" in confirmation email footer
findings.description: The footer of outbound confirmation emails misspells the company's own name as "BetterBrak" instead of BetterBark, and this appears on every confirmation email sent. The customer's comms lead flagged it; on the call Marcus confirmed it directly and the rep agreed it's a real, embarrassing typo that should be fixed, though it has no functional impact (no data risk, nothing broken, no member blocked). Agreed to be logged as a low-priority copy fix rather than an urgent escalation.
findings.quote: She noticed the confirmation emails your system sends have "BetterBrak" — B-E-T-T-E-R-B-R-A-K — in the footer.
findings.severity_reason: Purely cosmetic copy defect (brand-name typo) with no functional or data impact; a real but trivial defect per guidance.
findings.match_note: Not present in the tracked catalogue; distinct cosmetic text-defect issue, unrelated to any existing ticket.
